test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 29 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts and decide which conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the given

statements.

Statements:

All coats are jackets.

Some coats are sweaters.

Conclusions:

(I) Some jackets are not coats.

(II) Some jackets are sweaters.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b15ade543a3adc3aa7fa60d51e3b03947d944f4a9a246eefeb0535aeb519f52.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some jackets are not coats → **Not **Follow (As all coats are jackets, but we don't have the information related to the rest part of jacket, it can only be possible but not define, there, it is false)

(II) Some jackets are sweaters → Follow (As all coats are jackets and some coats are sweaters. As some part of sweaters is common with coats which whole comes in jackets, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion II follows .​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1"
